name: alert
title: Alert
purpose: Communicate important inline feedback or present a focused alert-dialog decision.
avoidFor: Transient feedback better served by Toast
accessibility: Inline mode uses alert semantics and does not move focus.
Dialog mode uses native modal alertdialog semantics, labels, initial focus, Escape handling, and focus restoration.
Persistent alerts disable every built-in dismissal path while retaining a clear task-specific action.
Every icon is decorative because the visible title and description communicate status.
commonMistakes: Using dialog mode for passive information.
Making a persistent dialog without a clear task-specific action.
Using success or warning color without matching content meaning.

examples.title: Inline information
examples.description: A surfaced information callout keeps supporting feedback in normal flow.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Alert from "@/components/ui/Alert.vue";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Alert id="feedback-alert" title="Alert heading placeholder" description="Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit." color="info">
    <template #actions="{ close }">
      <Button variant="outline" color="secondary" class="border-balsa-info text-balsa-info hover:bg-balsa-info/15 active:bg-balsa-info/25" @click="close">action</Button>
    </template>
  </Alert>
</template>

examples.title: Destructive alert dialog
examples.description: Dialog mode moves a consequential decision into the native top layer.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import Alert from "@/components/ui/Alert.vue";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";

const open = ref(false);
</script>

<template>
  <Button @click="open = true">Open alert placeholder</Button>
  <Alert v-model="open" id="feedback-alert" title="Alert heading placeholder" description="Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit." mode="dialog" color="destructive">
    <template #actions="{ close }">
      <Button variant="outline" color="secondary" class="border-balsa-destructive text-balsa-destructive hover:bg-balsa-destructive/15 active:bg-balsa-destructive/25" @click="close">Cancel placeholder</Button>
      <Button variant="outline" color="secondary" class="border-balsa-destructive text-balsa-destructive hover:bg-balsa-destructive/15 active:bg-balsa-destructive/25" @click="open = false">Confirm placeholder</Button>
    </template>
  </Alert>
</template>
